title: Strict manual-review evidence could not preserve an explicit historical 2.5.5 maintainer statement without fabrication

source_observation.environment: Post-publication 2.5.5 assurance calibration on Windows with the exact public archive and Factorio 2.0.77
source_observation.fact: The schema-2 observed-checklist mode required a precise review time, seven individual observations, and portable artifacts. The maintainer instead supplied an explicit historical release-authorization statement: the pre-publication playtest occurred, its exact time and per-check observations were not recorded, and its governed record was created later.

reproducer.expected: The governed record accepts only an immutable already-public package identity, records the later attestation time, preserves the unknown historical review time and absent per-check observations, and imports byte-identical content-addressed custody.
reproducer.observed: The exact public 2.5.5 archive, content identity, source commit, and Factorio 2.0.77 binary are bound without creating a false precise timestamp, screenshot, checklist observation, or pre-publication approval claim.

stable_id_and_migration_impact: none; historical evidence representation and custody only
